items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: we used to meet like Buddy Batiste... we'd challenge each other... we'd play

ctx.x: You never called it that term?

You have to go places to learn other things. Oh, of course, we used to meet like Buddy Batiste, we'd be an advertiser of color dance, we'd be advertising dance, we'd meet on the same corner, we'd challenge each other. Then they'd put one direction, we'd go another direction, we'd play, get over dirty with the instrument, you know?
